name: Fitzhugh-Nagumo
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="2">
    <description>
      A phenomenon called 'tip-splitting' or 'bifurcating stripes'. Recently observed in the growing palate of mice: <a href="http://www.nature.com/ng/journal/v44/n3/abs/ng.1090.html">Periodic stripe formation by a Turing mechanism operating at growth zones in the mammalian palate</a>
    </description>
    <rule name="Fitzhugh-Nagumo" type="formula" wrap="1">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.02
      </param>
      <param name="ConstSubB">
        -0.1
      </param>
      <param name="BMinusB">
        2
      </param>
      <param name="BScale">
        0.0166
      </param>
      <param name="DiffuseA">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="DiffuseB">
        4
      </param>
      <param name="AToA">
        0.77
      </param>
      <param name="SquaredAToA">
        -0.2
      </param>
      <param name="CubedAToA">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="AMinusB">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="AToB">
        1.2
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="2">
        delta_a = AToA*a - SquaredAToA*a*a - CubedAToA*a*a*a - AMinusB*b + DiffuseA*laplacian_a;
        delta_b = BScale*(AToB*a - BMinusB*b - ConstSubB) + DiffuseB*laplacian_b;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="false">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
        <constant value="-1">
          
        </constant>
        <everywhere>
          
        </everywhere>
        
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="0.6" high="1">
          
        </white_noise>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.2" y="0.4" z="0.4">
            
          </point3D>
          <point3D x="0.5" y="0.6" z="0.6">
            
          </point3D>
          
        </rectangle>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.5" y="0.5" z="0.6">
            
          </point3D>
          <point3D x="0.8" y="0.65" z="0.8">
            
          </point3D>
          
        </rectangle>
        
      </overlay>
      
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    <render_settings>
      <surface_color r="1" g="1" b="1">
        
      </surface_color>
